title: ship from main with local commits leaves local main diverged after the squash
body:
npm run ship started on main with unpushed local commits now weighs those commits when choosing the bar (bug_0635), but after the squash merge its final "git pull --ff-only" fails because local main has diverged from the squashed result. The landing succeeds; the local checkout is left needing a manual reset to origin/main. Either start ship from a fresh branch automatically when main has local commits, or reset local main to origin/main after a successful squash when every local commit is contained in the merged tree.

Audit report: https://claude.ai/artifact/SD45nGH1YqftoSvkxL8Hbb (2026-09-22, main c17192f9).
